result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner text has low contrast and is hard to read. Otherwise the page layout appears visually intact, excluding the intentionally scrollable rows and bottom-clipped content.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses white and very pale text on a light mint-green background, making '3 free deliveries for you' and especially the smaller code/terms line difficult to read due to insufficient contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text to a dark green or dark neutral color, or darken/saturate the banner background, so all banner text meets readable contrast levels.
